reason: Defines the small-team emergency/admin recovery posture MVP, scope limits, and acceptance criteria.
Maps existing Xirang auth/user/TOTP/recovery primitives to low-burden administrator recovery posture signals.
Backend Settings summary must remain admin-only, read-only, advisory-only, bounded, and leak-safe.
Implementation must not log raw user, TOTP, recovery-code, token, env, or audit evidence.
Frontend Settings API mapper must keep risk-code normalization type-safe and advisory-only.
Settings risk-summary card must remain accessible and avoid remediation controls.
